flavor.x: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.
flavor.y: For some time after its birth, it grows by gaining nourishment from the seed on its back.

flavor.x: There is a plant bulb on its back. When it absorbs nutrients, the bulb is said to blossom into a large flower.
flavor.y: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower’s coming bloom.

flavor.x: By spreading the broad petals of its flower and catching the sun’s rays, it fills its body with power.
flavor.y: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.

flavor.x: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander’s life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.
flavor.y: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

flavor.x: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.
flavor.y: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the air temperature to unbearably high levels.

flavor.x: When expelling a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.
flavor.y: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

flavor.x: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.
flavor.y: Shoots water at prey while in the water. Withdraws into its shell when in danger.

flavor.x: When tapped, this Pokémon will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.
flavor.y: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.

flavor.x: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.
flavor.y: The pressurized water jets on this brutal Pokémon’s shell are used for high-speed tackles.

flavor.x: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antennae on its head to drive away enemies.
flavor.y: Its feet have suction cups designed to stick to any surface. It tenaciously climbs trees to forage.

flavor.x: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.
flavor.y: This Pokémon is vulnerable to attack while its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

flavor.x: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.
flavor.y: The wings are protected by rain-repellent dust. As a result, this Pokémon can fly about even in rain.

flavor.x: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.
flavor.y: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

flavor.x: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.
flavor.y: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

flavor.x: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.
flavor.y: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

flavor.x: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.
flavor.y: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

flavor.x: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an Exeggcute to its nest over 60 miles away.
flavor.y: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

flavor.x: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.
flavor.y: It spreads its gorgeous wings widely to intimidate enemies. It races through the skies at Mach-2 speed.

flavor.x: Living wherever there is food available, it ceaselessly scavenges for edibles the entire day.
flavor.y: Its fangs are long and very sharp. They grow continuously, so it gnaws on hard things to whittle them down.

flavor.x: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.
flavor.y: The webs on its hind legs enable it to cross rivers. It searches wide areas for food.

flavor.x: Very protective of its territory, it flaps its short wings busily to dart around at high speed.
flavor.y: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne.

flavor.x: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.
flavor.y: It has the stamina to fly all day on its broad wings. It fights by using its sharp beak.

flavor.x: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.
flavor.y: Moving silently and stealthily, it eats the eggs of birds, such as Pidgey and Spearow, whole.

flavor.x: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.
flavor.y: To intimidate foes, it spreads its chest wide and makes eerie sounds by expelling air from its mouth.

flavor.x: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.
flavor.y: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.

flavor.x: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.
flavor.y: It can loose 100,000-volt bursts of electricity, instantly downing foes several times its size.

flavor.x: It burrows and lives underground. If threatened, it curls itself up into a ball for protection.
flavor.y: Disliking water, it lives in deep burrows in arid areas. It can roll itself instantly into a ball.

flavor.x: If it digs at an incredible pace, it may snap off its spikes and claws. They grow back in a day.
flavor.y: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.

flavor.x: Although small, its venomous barbs render this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.
flavor.y: Small and very docile, it protects itself with its small, poisonous horn when attacked.

flavor.x: The female has a gentle temperament. It emits ultrasonic cries that have the power to befuddle foes.
flavor.y: When feeding its young, it first chews the food into a paste, then spits it out for the offspring.

flavor.x: It uses its scaly, rugged body to seal the entrance of its nest and protect its young from predators.
flavor.y: The body is covered by stiff, needlelike scales. If it becomes excited, the needles bristle outwards.

flavor.x: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.
flavor.y: Its large ears are flapped like wings when it is listening to distant sounds. It extends toxic barbs when angered.

flavor.x: It raises its big ears to check its surroundings. If it senses anything, it attacks immediately.
flavor.y: An aggressive Pokémon that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

flavor.x: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide and its extended horn. Be careful with the horn, as it contains venom.
flavor.y: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.

flavor.x: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.
flavor.y: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.

flavor.x: Its hearing is so acute it can hear a pin drop over half a mile away. It lives on quiet mountains.
flavor.y: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

flavor.x: When it is born, it has just one snow-white tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.
flavor.y: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

flavor.x: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.
flavor.y: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

flavor.x: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.
flavor.y: If it inflates to sing a lullaby, it can perform longer and cause sure drowsiness in its audience.

flavor.x: Their fur feels so good that if two of them snuggle together, they won’t want to be separated.
flavor.y: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.

flavor.x: Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.
flavor.y: It has no eyes. Instead, it relies on its ultrasonic cries for echolocation to flit about in darkness.

flavor.x: Once it bites, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.
flavor.y: Once it starts sucking blood, it does not stop until it is full. It flies at night in search of prey.

flavor.x: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.
flavor.y: Its scientific name is “Oddium Wanderus.” At night, it is said to walk nearly 1,000 feet on its two roots.

flavor.x: Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.
flavor.y: The honey it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.

flavor.x: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.
flavor.y: It has the world’s largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

flavor.x: Growing out of the bug’s back are mushrooms called tochukaso. The mushrooms grow with the bug host.
flavor.y: Burrows under the ground to gnaw on tree roots. The mushrooms on its back absorb most of the nutrition.

flavor.x: A mushroom grown larger than the host’s body controls Parasect. It scatters poisonous spores.
flavor.y: The larger the mushroom on its back grows, the stronger the mushroom spores it scatters.

flavor.x: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.
flavor.y: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats bugs. It is attracted by light at night.

flavor.x: The scales it scatters will paralyze anyone who touches them, making that person unable to stand.
flavor.y: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

flavor.x: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.
flavor.y: Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light, its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak.

flavor.x: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.
flavor.y: Extremely powerful, they can dig through even the hardest ground to a depth of over 60 miles.

flavor.x: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.
flavor.y: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

flavor.x: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.
flavor.y: Its lithe muscles allow it to walk without making a sound. It attacks in an instant.

flavor.x: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.
flavor.y: It has mystical powers but doesn’t recall that it has used them. That is why it always looks puzzled.

flavor.x: It appears by waterways at dusk. It may use telekinetic powers if its forehead glows mysteriously.
flavor.y: The forelegs are webbed, helping to make it an adept swimmer. It can be seen swimming elegantly in lakes, etc.

flavor.x: It’s unsafe to approach if it gets violently enraged for no reason and can’t distinguish friends from foes.
flavor.y: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.

flavor.x: It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.
flavor.y: It is always outrageously furious. If it gives chase, it will tenaciously track the target no matter how far.

flavor.x: Very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.
flavor.y: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

flavor.x: A Pokémon that has long been admired for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.
flavor.y: Its magnificent bark conveys a sense of majesty. Anyone hearing it can’t help but grovel before it.

flavor.x: Its slick black skin is thin and damp. A part of its internal organs can be seen through the skin as a spiral pattern.
flavor.y: The direction of the spiral on the belly differs by area. It is more adept at swimming than walking.

flavor.x: It can live in or out of water. When out of water, it constantly sweats to keep its body slimy.
flavor.y: Its two legs are well developed. Even though it can live on the ground, it prefers living in water.

flavor.x: With its extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.
flavor.y: A swimmer adept at both the front crawl and breaststroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.

flavor.x: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. It uses a variety of extrasensory powers even while asleep.
flavor.y: It senses impending attacks and teleports away to safety before the actual attacks can strike.

flavor.x: When it uses its psychic power, it emits strong alpha waves that can ruin precision devices.
flavor.y: If it uses its abilities, it emits special alpha waves that cause machines to malfunction.

flavor.x: Its brain cells multiply continually until it dies. As a result, it remembers everything.
flavor.y: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its IQ (intelligence quotient) is said to be around 5,000.

flavor.x: It hefts a Graveler repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.
flavor.y: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it’s the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

flavor.x: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.
flavor.y: It can lift a dump truck with one hand. Using that power, it helps people with heavy jobs.

flavor.x: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.
flavor.y: It uses its four powerful arms to pin the limbs of its foe, then throws the victim over the horizon.

flavor.x: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.
flavor.y: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.

flavor.x: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.
flavor.y: It spits out Poison Powder to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of Acid.

flavor.x: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.
flavor.y: Once ingested into this Pokémon’s body, even the hardest object will melt into nothing.

flavor.x: Its body is virtually composed of water. It shoots strange beams from its crystal-like eyes.
flavor.y: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by their stingers.

flavor.x: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.

flavor.y: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

flavor.x: According to the legends of Sinnoh, this Pokémon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world.
flavor.y: It is told in mythology that this Pokémon was born before the universe even existed.

flavor.x: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.
flavor.y: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being’s entire body will be overflowing with power.

flavor.x: Being exposed to sunlight makes its movements swifter. It uses vines more adeptly than its hands.
flavor.y: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

flavor.x: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.
flavor.y: When it gets dirty, its leaves can’t be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.

flavor.x: It only gives its all against strong opponents who are not fazed by the glare from Serperior’s noble eyes.
flavor.y: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

flavor.x: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.
flavor.y: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.

flavor.x: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.
flavor.y: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

flavor.x: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.
flavor.y: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

flavor.x: The scalchop on its stomach isn’t just used for battle--it can be used to break open hard berries as well.
flavor.y: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

flavor.x: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.
flavor.y: As a result of strict training, each Dewott learns different forms for using the scalchops.

flavor.x: In the time it takes a foe to blink, it can draw and sheathe the seamitars attached to its front legs.
flavor.y: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

flavor.x: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.
flavor.y: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won’t notice a foe coming from behind.

flavor.x: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.
flavor.y: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

flavor.x: The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.
flavor.y: Though it is a very brave Pokémon, it’s also smart enough to check its foe’s strength and avoid battle.

flavor.x: This very loyal Pokémon helps Trainers, and it also takes care of other Pokémon.
flavor.y: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.

flavor.x: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.
flavor.y: Being wrapped in its long fur is so comfortable that a person would be fine even overnight on a wintry mountain.

flavor.x: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.
flavor.y: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can’t help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

flavor.x: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.
flavor.y: Stealthily, it sneaks up on its target, striking from behind before its victim has a chance to react.

flavor.x: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.
flavor.y: It’s good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It’s kind enough to share them with friends.

flavor.x: It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.
flavor.y: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

flavor.x: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.
flavor.y: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.

flavor.x: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.
flavor.y: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

flavor.x: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.
flavor.y: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

flavor.x: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.
flavor.y: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

flavor.x: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.
flavor.y: It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored mist.

flavor.x: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.
flavor.y: The dream mist coming from its forehead changes into many different colors depending on the dream that was eaten.

flavor.x: This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one.
flavor.y: These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

flavor.x: Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.
flavor.y: No matter where in the world it goes, it knows where its nest is, so it never gets separated from its Trainer.

flavor.x: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females’ flying abilities surpass those of the males.
flavor.y: Males have plumage on their heads. They will never let themselves feel close to anyone other than their Trainers.

flavor.x: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.
flavor.y: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

flavor.x: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.
flavor.y: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

flavor.x: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.
flavor.y: They were discovered a hundred years ago in an earthquake fissure. Inside each one is an energy core.

flavor.x: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.
flavor.y: When it is healthy, its core sticks out. Always facing the same way, it swiftly moves front to back and left to right.

flavor.x: The solar rays it absorbs are processed in its energy core and fired as a ball of light.
flavor.y: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

flavor.x: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.
flavor.y: The heart-shaped mark left on a body after a Woobat has been attached to it is said to bring good fortune.

flavor.x: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.
flavor.y: Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.

flavor.x: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.
flavor.y: By spinning its body, it can dig straight through the ground at a speed of 30 mph.

flavor.x: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.
flavor.y: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels.

flavor.x: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.
flavor.y: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

flavor.x: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.
flavor.y: Always carrying squared logs, they help out with construction. As they grow, they carry bigger logs.

flavor.x: With strengthened bodies, they skillfully wield steel beams to take down buildings.
flavor.y: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

flavor.x: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.
flavor.y: Rather than rely on force, they master moves that utilize the centrifugal force of spinning concrete.

flavor.x: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.
flavor.y: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.

flavor.x: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.
flavor.y: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to immobilize its opponents.

flavor.x: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.
flavor.y: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.

flavor.x: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.
flavor.y: When it encounters a foe bigger than itself, it wants to throw it. It changes belts as it gets stronger.

flavor.x: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.
flavor.y: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.

flavor.x: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.
flavor.y: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.

flavor.x: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.
flavor.y: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.

flavor.x: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.
flavor.y: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.

flavor.x: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.
flavor.y: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

flavor.x: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.
flavor.y: It is usually motionless, but when attacked, it rotates at high speed and then crashes into its opponent.

flavor.x: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.
flavor.y: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

flavor.x: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.
flavor.y: Perhaps because they feel more at ease in a group, they stick to others they find. They end up looking like a cloud.

flavor.x: They appear along with whirlwinds. They pull pranks, such as moving furniture and leaving balls of cotton in homes.
flavor.y: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.

flavor.x: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.
flavor.y: Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.

flavor.x: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.
flavor.y: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

flavor.x: Red- and blue-striped Basculin are very violent and always fighting. They are also remarkably tasty.
flavor.y: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other’s school.

flavor.x: It moves along below the sand’s surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.
flavor.y: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.

flavor.x: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.
flavor.y: The special membrane covering its eyes can sense the heat of objects, so it can see its surroundings even in darkness.

flavor.x: Very violent Pokémon, they try to clamp down on anything that moves in front of their eyes.
flavor.y: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

flavor.x: Darumaka’s droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.
flavor.y: When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into its body and its internal fire goes down to 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit.

flavor.x: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.
flavor.y: Its internal fire burns at 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

flavor.x: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.
flavor.y: Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.

flavor.x: It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.
flavor.y: When it finds a stone of a suitable size, it secretes a liquid from its mouth to open up a hole to crawl into.

flavor.x: It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.
flavor.y: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.

flavor.x: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.
flavor.y: Proud of its sturdy skull, it suddenly headbutts everything, but its weight makes it unstable, too.

flavor.x: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.
flavor.y: It can smash concrete blocks with its kicking attacks. The one with the biggest crest is the group leader.

flavor.x: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.
flavor.y: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders.

flavor.x: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves. Each retains memories of its former life.
flavor.y: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

flavor.x: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.
flavor.y: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.

flavor.x: About 100 million years ago, these Pokémon swam in oceans. It is thought they also went on land to attack prey.
flavor.y: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.

flavor.x: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.
flavor.y: It could knock out a foe with a slap from one of its developed front appendages and chew it up, shell or bones and all.

flavor.x: Revived from a fossil, this Pokémon is thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon.
flavor.y: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.

flavor.x: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.
flavor.y: It runs better than it flies. It takes off into the sky by running at a speed of 25 mph.

flavor.x: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.
flavor.y: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

flavor.x: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.
flavor.y: Consuming garbage makes new kinds of poison gases and liquids inside their bodies.

flavor.x: It changes so it looks just like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.
flavor.y: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

flavor.x: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.
flavor.y: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

flavor.x: Minccino greet each other by grooming one another thoroughly with their tails.
flavor.y: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.

flavor.x: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.
flavor.y: Cinccino’s body is coated in a special oil that helps it deflect attacks, such as punches.

flavor.x: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.
flavor.y: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something that only Gothita can see.

flavor.x: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.
flavor.y: According to many old tales, it creates friends for itself by controlling sleeping children on starry nights.

flavor.x: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.
flavor.y: They can predict the future from the placement and movement of the stars. They can see Trainers’ life spans.

flavor.x: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they are fine in any environment, no matter how severe.
flavor.y: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

flavor.x: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.
flavor.y: When their two divided brains think the same thoughts, their psychic power is maximized.

flavor.x: They use psychic power to control their arms, which are made of a special liquid. They can crush boulders psychically.
flavor.y: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.

flavor.x: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.
flavor.y: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

flavor.x: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.
flavor.y: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

flavor.x: The temperature of their breath is -58 degrees Fahrenheit. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.
flavor.y: This Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. It sleeps buried in snow.

flavor.x: They cool down the surrounding air and create ice particles, which they use to freeze their foes.
flavor.y: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon’s habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.

flavor.x: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.
flavor.y: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and, when angry, cause violent blizzards.

flavor.x: Their coloring changes according to the seasons and can be slightly affected by the temperature and humidity as well.
flavor.y: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon’s fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

flavor.x: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.
flavor.y: They migrate according to the seasons, so some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring.

flavor.x: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.
flavor.y: The energy made in its cheeks’ electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.

flavor.x: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.
flavor.y: For some reason they evolve when they receive electrical energy while they are attacking Shelmet.

flavor.x: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.
flavor.y: These Pokémon evolve by wearing the shell covering of a Shelmet. The steel armor protects their whole body.

flavor.x: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.
flavor.y: It lures Pokémon with its pattern that looks just like a Poké Ball, then releases poison spores.

flavor.x: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.
flavor.y: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.

flavor.x: They paralyze prey with poison, then drag them down to their lairs, five miles below the surface.
flavor.y: If its veil-like arms stun and wrap a foe, that foe will be dragged miles below the surface, never to return.

flavor.x: Its body is mostly seawater. It’s said there’s a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.
flavor.y: The fate of the ships and crew that wander into Jellicent’s habitat: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.

flavor.x: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.
flavor.y: It gently holds injured and weak Pokémon in its fins. Its special membrane heals their wounds.

flavor.x: Since it can’t generate its own electricity, it sticks onto large-bodied Pokémon and absorbs static electricity.
flavor.y: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

flavor.x: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.
flavor.y: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

flavor.x: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.
flavor.y: It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock while clinging to the ceiling. It shoots spikes when in danger.

flavor.x: By swinging around its three spiky feelers and shooting spikes, it can obliterate an opponent.
flavor.y: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.

flavor.x: Interlocking two bodies and spinning around generates the energy they need to live.
flavor.y: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

flavor.x: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.
flavor.y: A minigear and big gear comprise its body. If the minigear it launches at a foe doesn’t return, it will die.

flavor.x: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.
flavor.y: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.

flavor.x: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
flavor.y: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

flavor.x: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.
flavor.y: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

flavor.x: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.
flavor.y: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

flavor.x: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent’s brain, causing unendurable headaches.
flavor.y: Rumors of its origin are linked to a UFO crash site in the desert 50 years ago.

flavor.x: Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three fingers, but those patterns haven’t been decoded.
flavor.y: It uses psychic power to control an opponent’s brain and tamper with its memories.

flavor.x: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.
flavor.y: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

flavor.x: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.
flavor.y: It arrives near the moment of death and steals spirit from the body.

flavor.x: Being consumed in Chandelure’s flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.
flavor.y: The spirits burned up in its ominous flame lose their way and wander this world forever.

flavor.x: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.
flavor.y: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly.

flavor.x: Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.
flavor.y: A broken tusk will not grow back, so it diligently sharpens its tusks on river rocks after the end of a battle.

flavor.x: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.
flavor.y: Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams. These Pokémon are covered in hard armor.

flavor.x: Its nose is always running. It sniffs the snot back up because the mucus provides the raw material for its moves.
flavor.y: Their snot is a barometer of health. When healthy, their snot is sticky and the power of their ice moves increases.

flavor.x: They love the cold seas of the north. They create pathways across the ocean waters by freezing their own breath.
flavor.y: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Cold northern areas are its habitat.

flavor.x: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.
flavor.y: They are composed of ice crystals. They capture prey with chains of ice, freezing the prey at -148 degrees Fahrenheit.

flavor.x: When it and Karrablast are together, and both receive electrical stimulation, they both evolve.
flavor.y: It evolves when bathed in an electric-like energy along with Karrablast. The reason is still unknown.

flavor.x: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.
flavor.y: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.

flavor.x: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.
flavor.y: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.

flavor.x: It takes pride in the speed at which it can use moves. What it loses in power, it makes up for in quantity.
flavor.y: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

flavor.x: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.
flavor.y: Using the long fur on its arms like whips, it launches into combo attacks that, once started, no one can stop.

flavor.x: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.
flavor.y: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.

flavor.x: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.
flavor.y: Ancient science fashioned this Pokémon from clay. It’s been active for thousands of years.

flavor.x: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.
flavor.y: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

flavor.x: Blades comprise this Pokémon’s entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.
flavor.y: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.

flavor.x: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It then moves in to finish the prey off.
flavor.y: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

flavor.x: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.
flavor.y: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.

flavor.x: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.
flavor.y: They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear. Their frequent fights help them become stronger.

flavor.x: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if injured.
flavor.y: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

flavor.x: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.
flavor.y: Their wings are too tiny to allow them to fly. They guard their posteriors with bones that were gathered by Mandibuzz.

flavor.x: They fly in circles around the sky. When they spot prey, they attack and carry it back to their nest with ease.
flavor.y: Watching from the sky, they swoop to strike weakened Pokémon on the ground. They decorate themselves with bones.

flavor.x: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant’s steel bodies and consume their insides.
flavor.y: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. It melts Durant and eats them.

flavor.x: Individuals each play different roles in driving Heatmor, their natural predator, away from their colony.
flavor.y: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

flavor.x: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.
flavor.y: Lacking sight, it’s unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves.

flavor.x: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.
flavor.y: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

flavor.x: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.
flavor.y: It responds to movement by attacking. This scary, three-headed Pokémon devours everything in its path!

flavor.x: Said to have been born from the sun, it spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.
flavor.y: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.

flavor.x: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.
flavor.y: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona’s fire provided a replacement for the sun.

flavor.x: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.
flavor.y: It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.

flavor.x: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.
flavor.y: Spoken of in legend, this Pokémon used its phenomenal power to destroy a castle in its effort to protect Pokémon.

flavor.x: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.
flavor.y: Legends say this Pokémon confounded opponents with its swift movements.

flavor.x: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.
flavor.y: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.

flavor.x: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.
flavor.y: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.

flavor.x: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with fire. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.
flavor.y: When Reshiram’s tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world’s weather.

flavor.x: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with lightning. It assists those who want to build an ideal world.
flavor.y: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.

flavor.x: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”
flavor.y: From the forces of lightning and wind, it creates energy to give nutrients to the soil and make the land abundant.

flavor.x: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.
flavor.y: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

flavor.x: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.
flavor.y: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

flavor.x: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.
flavor.y: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

flavor.x: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.
flavor.y: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

flavor.x: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.
flavor.y: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn’t faze it.

flavor.x: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators’ attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.
flavor.y: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won’t start fights.

flavor.x: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.
flavor.y: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.

flavor.x: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.
flavor.y: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

flavor.x: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.
flavor.y: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

flavor.x: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.
flavor.y: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

flavor.x: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.
flavor.y: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

flavor.x: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.
flavor.y: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute’s time.

flavor.x: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.
flavor.y: It appears and vanishes with a ninja’s grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

flavor.x: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.
flavor.y: It has ears like shovels. Digging holes strengthens its ears so much that they can sever thick roots effortlessly.

flavor.x: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.
flavor.y: As powerful as an excavator, its ears can reduce dense bedrock to rubble. When it’s finished digging, it lounges lazily.

flavor.x: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.
flavor.y: Despite the beauty of its lilting voice, it’s merciless to intruders that enter its territory.

flavor.x: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.
flavor.y: The hotter the flame sac on its belly, the faster it can fly, but it takes some time to get the fire going.

flavor.x: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.
flavor.y: When attacking prey, it can reach speeds of up to 310 mph. It finishes its prey off with a colossal kick.

flavor.x: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.
flavor.y: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

flavor.x: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.
flavor.y: The beaks of bird Pokémon can’t begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

flavor.x: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.
flavor.y: The patterns on this Pokémon’s wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

flavor.x: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.
flavor.y: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.

flavor.x: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.
flavor.y: With fiery breath of more than 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, they viciously threaten any challenger. The females protect the pride’s cubs.

flavor.x: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.
flavor.y: When it finds a flower it likes, it dwells on that flower its whole life long. It floats in the wind’s embrace with an untroubled heart.

flavor.x: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.
flavor.y: When the flowers of a well-tended flower bed bloom, it appears and celebrates with an elegant dance.

flavor.x: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.
flavor.y: In times long past, governors of castles would invite Florges to create flower gardens to embellish the castle domains.

flavor.x: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.
flavor.y: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn’t need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

flavor.x: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.
flavor.y: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

flavor.x: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.
flavor.y: It does its level best to glare and pull a scary face, but it can’t help grinning if anyone pats its head.

flavor.x: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won’t put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.
flavor.y: It charges ahead and bashes its opponents like a berserker, uncaring about any hits it might take. Its arms are mighty enough to snap a telephone pole.

flavor.x: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.
flavor.y: Historically, in the Kalos region, these Pokémon were the designated guardians of the king.

flavor.x: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.
flavor.y: It has enough psychic energy to blast everything within 300 feet of itself, but it has no control over its power.

flavor.x: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.
flavor.y: The eyeball patterns on the interior of its ears emit psychic energy. It keeps the patterns tightly covered because that power is too immense.

flavor.x: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.
flavor.y: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person’s arm and drains that person’s life energy completely.

flavor.x: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.
flavor.y: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.

flavor.x: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.
flavor.y: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.

flavor.x: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.
flavor.y: In the past, rather than using perfume, royal ladies carried a Spritzee that would waft a fragrance they liked.

flavor.x: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.
flavor.y: Its scent is so overpowering that, unless a Trainer happens to really enjoy the smell, he or she will have a hard time walking alongside it.

flavor.x: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.
flavor.y: Because it eats nothing but sweets, its fur is as sticky sweet as cotton candy.

flavor.x: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.
flavor.y: Its sense of smell is 100 million times better than a human’s, so even the faintest scent tells it about everything in the area. It’s like it can see with its nose!

flavor.x: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.
flavor.y: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent’s will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.

flavor.x: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.
flavor.y: It lures its prey close with hypnotic motions, then wraps its tentacles around it before finishing it off with digestive fluids.

flavor.x: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.
flavor.y: They stretch and then contract, yanking their rocks along with them in bold hops. They eat seaweed that washes up on the shoreline.

flavor.x: When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.
flavor.y: Barbaracle’s legs and hands have minds of their own, and they will move independently. But they usually follow the head’s orders.

flavor.x: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.
flavor.y: It looks just like rotten kelp. It hides from foes while storing up power for its evolution.

flavor.x: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.
flavor.y: Tales are told of ships that wander into seas where Dragalge live, never to return.

flavor.x: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.
flavor.y: Through controlled explosions of internal gas, it can expel water like a pistol shot. At close distances, it can shatter rock.

flavor.x: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.
flavor.y: By expelling water from the nozzle in the back of its claw, it can move at a speed of 60 knots.

flavor.x: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.
flavor.y: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.

flavor.x: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.
flavor.y: It stimulates its muscles with electricity, boosting the strength in its legs and enabling it to run 100 yards in five seconds.

flavor.x: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn’t like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.
flavor.y: Its immense jaws have enough destructive force that it can chew up an automobile. It lived 100 million years ago.

flavor.x: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.
flavor.y: Nothing could stop this Pokémon 100 million years ago, so it behaved like a king.

flavor.x: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.
flavor.y: This calm Pokémon lived in a cold land where there were no violent predators like Tyrantrum.

flavor.x: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.
flavor.y: Using its diamond-shaped crystals, it can instantly create a wall of ice to block an opponent’s attack.

flavor.x: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.
flavor.y: It wraps its ribbonlike feelers around the arm of its beloved Trainer and walks with him or her.

flavor.x: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.
flavor.y: With its wings, it controls its position in the air. It likes to attack from above, a maneuver that is difficult to defend against.

flavor.x: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.
flavor.y: It uses its tail to absorb electricity from power plants or from outlets in houses, and then it fires the electricity from its whiskers.

flavor.x: Born from the temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.
flavor.y: It has slept underground for hundreds of millions of years since its birth. It’s occasionally found during the excavation of caves.

flavor.x: The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn’t dry out.
flavor.y: It’s covered in a slimy membrane that makes any punches or kicks slide off it harmlessly.

flavor.x: It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can’t see anything.
flavor.y: Its four horns are a high-performance radar system. It uses them to sense sounds and smells, rather than using ears or a nose.

flavor.x: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.
flavor.y: It attacks with retractable horns. It throws a punch that’s the equivalent of the force of a hundred pro boxers.

flavor.x: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.
flavor.y: It never lets go of a key that it likes, so people give it the keys to vaults and safes as a way to prevent crime.

flavor.x: These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. They prefer to live in abandoned forests.
flavor.y: According to old tales, these Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died while lost in the forest.

flavor.x: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.
flavor.y: Using its roots as a nervous system, it controls the trees in the forest. It’s kind to the Pokémon that reside in its body.

flavor.x: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.
flavor.y: It is said to carry wandering spirits to the place where they belong so they can move on.

flavor.x: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.
flavor.y: It enwraps its prey in its hairlike arms. It sings joyfully as it observes the suffering of its prey.

flavor.x: It blocks opponents’ attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice.
flavor.y: Using air of -150 degrees Fahrenheit, they freeze opponents solid. They live in herds above the snow line on mountains.

flavor.x: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.
flavor.y: The way several Bergmite huddle on its back makes it look like an aircraft carrier made of ice.

flavor.x: They live in pitch-black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.
flavor.y: Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and unable to stand when exposed to its 200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

flavor.x: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.
flavor.y: The ultrasonic waves it emits from its ears can reduce a large boulder to pebbles. It swoops out of the dark to attack.

flavor.x: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.
flavor.y: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

flavor.x: When this legendary Pokémon’s wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.
flavor.y: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

flavor.x: When the Kalos region’s ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.
flavor.y: It’s hypothesized that it’s monitoring those who destroy the ecosystem from deep in the cave where it lives.

flavor.x: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.
flavor.y: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

flavor.x: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.
flavor.y: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

flavor.x: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It’s said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.
flavor.y: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.
